verses.pali: “Katihi nu kho, bhante, dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā nissayo dātabbo”ti?
verses.english: “Sir, how many qualities should a mendicant have to give dependence?”

verses.pali: “Dasahi kho, upāli, dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā nissayo dātabbo.
verses.english: “Upāli, a mendicant should have ten qualities to give dependence.

verses.pali: Idhupāli, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu;
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant is ethical …

verses.pali: pātimokkhaṁ kho panassa vitthārena svāgataṁ hoti suvibhattaṁ suppavattaṁ suvinicchitaṁ suttaso anubyañjanaso;
verses.english: Both monastic codes have been passed down to them in detail, well analyzed, well mastered, well evaluated in both the rules and accompanying material.

verses.pali: paṭibalo hoti gilānaṁ upaṭṭhātuṁ vā upaṭṭhāpetuṁ vā;
verses.english: They’re able to care for the sick or get someone else to do so.

verses.pali: paṭibalo hoti anabhiratiṁ vūpakāsetuṁ vā vūpakāsāpetuṁ vā;
verses.english: They’re able to settle dissatisfaction or get someone else to do so.

verses.pali: paṭibalo hoti uppannaṁ kukkuccaṁ dhammato vinodetuṁ;
verses.english: They’re able to dispel remorse when it has come up.

verses.pali: paṭibalo hoti uppannaṁ diṭṭhigataṁ dhammato vivecetuṁ;
verses.english: They’re able to rationally dissuade someone from misconceptions that come up.
They’re able to encourage someone in the higher ethics,

verses.pali: Imehi kho, upāli, dasahi dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā nissayo dātabbo”ti.
verses.english: A mendicant should possess these ten qualities to give dependence.”
